hypotheses.H1: Time-dependent weighting centered at log(P_r / sigma_eff^2) = 0 improves the generative-quality or ordinary-denoising-loss trajectory relative to baseline.
hypotheses.H2: Moving-frontier weighting outperforms static weighting with matched marginal frequency emphasis.
hypotheses.H3: Moving-frontier weighting changes nearest-neighbor memorization at matched generative quality.

spectrum_gate.decision: Use the 50K spectrum if max absolute per-shell relative change exceeds 0.05, more than 0.05 of DDPM timesteps change R_MI, or any DDPM crossing moves by more than one shell; otherwise retain E006-1K.
spectrum_gate.interpretation: Use 50K spectrum by preregistered rule; 1K and 50K frontier estimates are nevertheless highly stable.
spectrum_gate.sensitivity_caveat: The 5% criterion fired only at r=22, which has one coefficient per channel; 19/1000 DDPM timesteps changed R_MI by at most one shell and no E006-grid crossing changed.

static_matched_narrow.definition: bar_w_r = mean over all 1000 uniformly weighted DDPM timesteps of the coefficient-mean-normalized boundary_narrow w_t,r

rng_isolation.requirement: Within each pair, all conditions use identical initialization, minibatch order, timesteps, and epsilon draws.

training.primary_range: full DDPM schedule; no wild-middle gating
training.continuation_rule: Stop after every condition reaches 20K for scientific review. Stop an individual run early only for nonfinite values, clear numerical divergence, checkpoint corruption, or infrastructure failure; observed relative quality is never an early-stop criterion. Do not select a winner at 20K and do not launch 50K continuations automatically.

heldout_denoising.fixed_timestep_assignment: stratified across 0:999 and materialized before training

generative_quality.timing: median optimizer-step duration after warmup, excluding evaluation

memorization.evaluator: exact pinned CIFAR-1K Fourier nearest-neighbor evaluator; identity and thresholds must be recorded before training
